name: agent-index-filesystem-gdrive
description: Filesystem adapter for Google Drive and Shared Drives. v2.6.0 (Platform Reliability): byte-exact reads (no appended newline), stat-gated retry on empty/NOT_FOUND reads (AIFS_READ_UNRELIABLE instead of silent empties), content_file/stdin write payloads (no ~128KB CLI-arg cap), and sentinel-aware post-write verification (AIFS:FILE-END; AIFS_WRITE_VERIFY_FAILED on tail loss). v2.5.0 added id-anchored path resolution (id:{folderId}/rel).
author: agent-index

client_id.description: OAuth 2.0 client ID from the org's Google Cloud project.

client_secret.description: OAuth 2.0 client secret from the org's Google Cloud project.

drive_id.description: Google Shared Drive ID. Omit for personal Drive.

root_folder_id.description: Folder ID to use as filesystem root. Omit for Drive root.

all_members_group.description: Email address of the Workspace-maintained Google Group whose membership is the authoritative agent-index member roster. Admin-published infrastructure files (CLAUDE.md, org-config.json, members-registry.json, bootstrap zip, marketplace cache) are shared with this address. Optional but warned-if-missing in v3.1.0+; required for invite-member and other admin tasks that share content with all members.
